units.rightText: But ye shall be named the priests of Jehovah; men shall call you the ministers of our God: ye shall eat the wealth of the nations, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

units.leftText: Instead of shame, My people will have a double portion, and instead of humiliation, they will rejoice in their share; and so they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.
units.rightText: Instead of your shame ye shall have double; and instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess double; everlasting joy shall be unto them.

units.leftText: For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
units.rightText: For I, Jehovah, love justice, I hate robbery with iniquity; and I will give them their recompense in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

units.leftText: Their descendants will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed.
units.rightText: And their seed shall be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples; all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which Jehovah hath blessed.

units.leftText: I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
units.rightText: I will greatly rejoice in Jehovah, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with a garland, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

units.leftText: For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
units.rightText: For as the earth bringeth forth its bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord Jehovah will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

units.leftText: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep still, until her righteousness shines like a bright light, her salvation like a blazing torch.
units.rightText: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a lamp that burneth.

units.leftText: Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
units.rightText: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory, and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of Jehovah shall name.

units.leftText: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
units.rightText: Thou shalt also be a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

units.leftText: No longer will you be called Forsaken, nor your land named Desolate; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be His bride.
units.rightText: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah; for Jehovah delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
leftNotes: 62:4 Hebrew Azubah
62:4 Hebrew Shemamah
62:4 Hephzibah means My delight is in her.
62:4 Beulah means married.

units.leftText: For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
units.rightText: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee; and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.

units.leftText: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD shall take no rest for yourselves,
units.rightText: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem; they shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that are Jehovah’s remembrancers, take ye no rest,

units.leftText: nor give Him any rest until He establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.
units.rightText: and give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

units.leftText: The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain to your enemies for food, nor will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy grain to be food for thine enemies; and foreigners shall not drink thy new wine, for which thou hast labored:

units.leftText: For those who harvest grain will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather grapes will drink the wine in My holy courts.”
units.rightText: but they that have garnered it shall eat it, and praise Jehovah; and they that have gathered it shall drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.

units.leftText: Go out, go out through the gates; prepare the way for the people! Build it up, build up the highway; clear away the stones; raise a banner for the nations!
units.rightText: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up an ensign for the peoples.

units.leftText: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
units.rightText: Behold, Jehovah hath proclaimed unto the end of the earth, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.

units.leftText: And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
units.rightText: And they shall call them The holy people, The redeemed of Jehovah: and thou shalt be called Sought out, A city not forsaken.

units.leftText: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah with crimson-stained garments? Who is this robed in splendor, marching in the greatness of His strength? “It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.”
units.rightText: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, marching in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
leftNotes: 63:1 Or It is I, speaking in righteousness,

units.leftText: Why are Your clothes red, and Your garments like one who treads the winepress?
units.rightText: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winevat?

units.leftText: “I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me. I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury; their blood spattered My garments, and all My clothes were stained.
units.rightText: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the peoples there was no man with me: yea, I trod them in mine anger, and trampled them in my wrath; and their lifeblood is sprinkled upon my garments, and I have stained all my raiment.

units.leftText: For the day of vengeance was in My heart, and the year of My redemption had come.
units.rightText: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

units.leftText: I looked, but there was no one to help; I was appalled that no one assisted. So My arm brought Me salvation, and My own wrath upheld Me.
units.rightText: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my wrath, it upheld me.

units.leftText: I trampled the nations in My anger; in My wrath I made them drunk and poured out their blood on the ground.” God’s Mercies Recalled
units.rightText: And I trod down the peoples in mine anger, and made them drunk in my wrath, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth.

units.leftText: I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
units.rightText: I will make mention of the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah, and the praises of Jehovah, according to all that Jehovah hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

units.leftText: For He said, “They are surely My people, sons who will not be disloyal.” So He became their Savior.
units.rightText: For he said, Surely, they are my people, children that will not deal falsely: so he was their Saviour.

units.leftText: In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
units.rightText: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
leftNotes: 63:9 Or angel of His presence

units.leftText: But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit. So He turned and became their enemy, and He Himself fought against them.
units.rightText: But they rebelled, and grieved his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and himself fought against them.

units.leftText: Then His people remembered the days of old, the days of Moses. Where is He who brought them through the sea with the shepherds of His flock? Where is the One who set His Holy Spirit among them,
units.rightText: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit in the midst of them?

units.leftText: who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
units.rightText: that caused his glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses? that divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

units.leftText: who led them through the depths like a horse in the wilderness, so that they did not stumble?
units.rightText: that led them through the depths, as a horse in the wilderness, so that they stumbled not?

units.leftText: Like cattle going down to the valley, the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way to make for Yourself a glorious name. A Prayer for Mercy (Jeremiah 14:19–22|JER 14:19-22*)
units.rightText: As the cattle that go down into the valley, the Spirit of Jehovah caused them to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

units.leftText: Look down from heaven and see, from Your holy and glorious habitation. Where are Your zeal and might? Your yearning and compassion for me are restrained.
units.rightText: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where are thy zeal and thy mighty acts? the yearning of thy heart and thy compassions are restrained toward me.

units.leftText: Yet You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, O LORD, are our Father; our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name.
units.rightText: For thou art our Father, though Abraham knoweth us not, and Israel doth not acknowledge us: thou, O Jehovah, art our Father; our Redeemer from everlasting is thy name.

units.leftText: Why, O LORD, do You make us stray from Your ways and harden our hearts from fearing You? Return, for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, why dost thou make us to err from thy ways, and hardenest our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants’ sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

units.leftText: For a short while Your people possessed Your holy place, but our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary.
units.rightText: Thy holy people possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

units.leftText: We have become like those You never ruled, like those not called by Your name.
units.rightText: We are become as they over whom thou never barest rule, as they that were not called by thy name.

units.leftText: If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
units.rightText: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might quake at thy presence,

units.leftText: as fire kindles the brushwood and causes the water to boil, to make Your name known to Your enemies, so that the nations will tremble at Your presence!
units.rightText: as when fire kindleth the brushwood, and the fire causeth the waters to boil; to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!

units.leftText: When You did awesome works that we did not expect, You came down, and the mountains trembled at Your presence.
units.rightText: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains quaked at thy presence.

units.leftText: From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
units.rightText: For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen a God besides thee, who worketh for him that waiteth for him.
leftNotes: 64:4 Cited in 1 Corinthians 2:9|1CO 2:9*

units.leftText: You welcome those who gladly do right, who remember Your ways. Surely You were angry, for we sinned. How can we be saved if we remain in our sins?
units.rightText: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou wast wroth, and we sinned: in them have we been of long time; and shall we be saved?

units.leftText: Each of us has become like something unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us away like the wind.
units.rightText: For we are all become as one that is unclean, and all our righteousnesses are as a polluted garment: and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away.
leftNotes: 64:6 Or like a stained menstrual garment

units.leftText: No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity.
units.rightText: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee; for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us by means of our iniquities.
leftNotes: 64:7 LXX, Syriac, and Targum Yonaton; MT have made us melt in the hand

units.leftText: But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are the potter; we are all the work of Your hand.
units.rightText: But now, O Jehovah, thou art our Father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

units.leftText: Do not be angry, O LORD, beyond measure; do not remember our iniquity forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray; we are all Your people!
units.rightText: Be not wroth very sore, O Jehovah, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, look, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.

units.leftText: Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wasteland and Jerusalem a desolation.
units.rightText: Thy holy cities are become a wilderness, Zion is become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

units.leftText: Our holy and beautiful temple, where our fathers praised You, has been burned with fire, and all that was dear to us lies in ruins.
units.rightText: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned with fire; and all our pleasant places are laid waste.

units.leftText: After all this, O LORD, will You restrain Yourself? Will You keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?
units.rightText: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Jehovah? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?

units.leftText: “I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me; I was found by those who did not seek Me. To a nation that did not call My name, I said, ‘Here I am! Here I am!’
units.rightText: I am inquired of by them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
leftNotes: 65:1 Cited in Romans 10:20|ROM 10:20*

units.leftText: All day long I have held out My hands to an obstinate people who walk in the wrong path, who follow their own imaginations,
units.rightText: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, that walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;
leftNotes: 65:2 LXX to a disobedient and obstinate people; cited in Romans 10:21|ROM 10:21*

units.leftText: to a people who continually provoke Me to My face, sacrificing in the gardens and burning incense on altars of brick,
units.rightText: a people that provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense upon bricks;

units.leftText: sitting among the graves, spending nights in secret places, eating the meat of pigs and polluted broth from their bowls.
units.rightText: that sit among the graves, and lodge in the secret places; that eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

units.leftText: They say, ‘Keep to yourself; do not come near me, for I am holier than you!’ Such people are smoke in My nostrils, a fire that burns all day long.
units.rightText: that say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me, for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

units.leftText: Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will pay it back into their laps,
units.rightText: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, yea, I will recompense into their bosom,

units.leftText: both for your iniquities and for those of your fathers,” says the LORD. “Because they burned incense on the mountains and scorned Me on the hills, I will measure into their laps full payment for their former deeds.”
units.rightText: your own iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith Jehovah, that have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I first measure their work into their bosom.

units.leftText: This is what the LORD says: “As the new wine is found in a cluster of grapes, and men say, ‘Do not destroy it, for it contains a blessing,’ so I will act on behalf of My servants; I will not destroy them all.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not, for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.

units.leftText: And I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and heirs from Judah; My elect will possess My mountains, and My servants will dwell there.
units.rightText: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains; and my chosen shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
leftNotes: 65:9 Or and heirs to My mountains out of Judah; My elect will possess them

units.leftText: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for My people who seek Me.
units.rightText: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

units.leftText: But you who forsake the LORD, who forget My holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,
units.rightText: But ye that forsake Jehovah, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for Fortune, and that fill up mingled wine unto Destiny;
leftNotes: 65:11 Hebrew Gad, the Babylonian god of fortune
65:11 Hebrew Meni, the Babylonian god of fate

units.leftText: I will destine you for the sword, and you will all kneel down to be slaughtered, because I called and you did not answer, I spoke and you did not listen; you did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
units.rightText: I will destine you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but ye did that which was evil in mine eyes, and chose that wherein I delighted not.

units.leftText: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; My servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; My servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry; behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty; behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be put to shame;

units.leftText: My servants will shout for joy with a glad heart, but you will cry out with a heavy heart and wail with a broken spirit.
units.rightText: behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall wail for vexation of spirit.

units.leftText: You will leave behind your name as a curse for My chosen ones, and the Lord GOD will slay you; but to His servants He will give another name.
units.rightText: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen; and the Lord Jehovah will slay thee; and he will call his servants by another name:

units.leftText: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth, and whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the former troubles will be forgotten and hidden from My sight. A New Heaven and a New Earth (Revelation 21:1–8|REV 21:1-8*)
units.rightText: so that he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

units.leftText: For behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.
units.rightText: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
leftNotes: 65:17 LXX a new heaven and a new earth; see also Isaiah 66:22|ISA 66:22* and Revelation 21:1.

units.leftText: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I create; for I will create Jerusalem to be a joy and its people to be a delight.
units.rightText: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

units.leftText: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people. The sounds of weeping and crying will no longer be heard in her.
units.rightText: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people; and there shall be heard in her no more the voice of weeping and the voice of crying.

units.leftText: No longer will a nursing infant live but a few days, or an old man fail to live out his years. For the youth will die at a hundred years, and he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.
units.rightText: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days; for the child shall die a hundred years old, and the sinner being a hundred years old shall be accursed.

units.leftText: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
units.rightText: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

units.leftText: No longer will they build houses for others to inhabit, nor plant for others to eat. For as is the lifetime of a tree, so will be the days of My people, and My chosen ones will fully enjoy the work of their hands.
units.rightText: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree shall be the days of my people, and my chosen shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

units.leftText: They will not labor in vain or bear children doomed to disaster; for they will be a people blessed by the LORD — they and their descendants with them.
units.rightText: They shall not labor in vain, nor bring forth for calamity; for they are the seed of the blessed of Jehovah, and their offspring with them.

units.leftText: Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass that, before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

units.leftText: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, but the food of the serpent will be dust. They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the ox; and dust shall be the serpent’s food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith Jehovah.
leftNotes: 65:25 Hebrew nachash; translated in most cases as snake

units.leftText: This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me? Or where will My place of repose be?
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: what manner of house will ye build unto me? and what place shall be my rest?

units.leftText: Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,” declares the LORD. “This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at My word.
units.rightText: For all these things hath my hand made, and so all these things came to be, saith Jehovah: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and that trembleth at my word.
leftNotes: 66:2 Cited in Acts 7:49–50|ACT 7:49-50*

units.leftText: Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man; whoever sacrifices a lamb is like one who breaks a dog’s neck; whoever presents a grain offering is like one who offers pig’s blood; whoever offers frankincense is like one who blesses an idol. Indeed, they have chosen their own ways and delighted in their abominations.
units.rightText: He that killeth an ox is as he that slayeth a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as he that breaketh a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation, as he that offereth swine’s blood; he that burneth frankincense, as he that blesseth an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations:

units.leftText: So I will choose their punishment and I will bring terror upon them, because I called and no one answered, I spoke and no one listened. But they did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”
units.rightText: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did that which was evil in mine eyes, and chose that wherein I delighted not.

units.leftText: You who tremble at His word, hear the word of the LORD: “Your brothers who hate you and exclude you because of My name have said, ‘Let the LORD be glorified that we may see your joy!’ But they will be put to shame.”
units.rightText: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye that tremble at his word: Your brethren that hate you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, have said, Let Jehovah be glorified, that we may see your joy; but it is they that shall be put to shame.

units.leftText: Hear the uproar from the city; listen to the voice from the temple! It is the voice of the LORD, repaying His enemies what they deserve! Rejoice with Jerusalem
units.rightText: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Jehovah that rendereth recompense to his enemies.

units.leftText: “Before she was in labor, she gave birth; before she was in pain, she delivered a boy.
units.rightText: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man-child.

units.leftText: Who has heard of such as this? Who has seen such things? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be delivered in an instant? Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.
units.rightText: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? shall a nation be brought forth at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

units.leftText: Shall I bring a baby to the point of birth and not deliver it?” says the LORD. “Or will I who deliver close the womb?” says your God.
units.rightText: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith Jehovah: shall I that cause to bring forth shut the womb? saith thy God.

units.leftText: Be glad for Jerusalem and rejoice over her, all who love her. Rejoice greatly with her, all who mourn over her,
units.rightText: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn over her;

units.leftText: so that you may nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you may drink deeply and delight yourselves in her glorious abundance.
units.rightText: that ye may suck and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

units.leftText: For this is what the LORD says: “I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flowing stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm, and bounced upon her knees.
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream: and ye shall suck thereof; ye shall be borne upon the side, and shall be dandled upon the knees.

units.leftText: As a mother comforts her son, so will I comfort you, and you will be consoled over Jerusalem.”
units.rightText: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

units.leftText: When you see, you will rejoice, and you will flourish like grass; then the hand of the LORD will be revealed to His servants, but His wrath will be shown to His enemies. Final Judgments against the Wicked
units.rightText: And ye shall see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like the tender grass: and the hand of Jehovah shall be known toward his servants; and he will have indignation against his enemies.

units.leftText: For behold, the LORD will come with fire— His chariots are like a whirlwind— to execute His anger with fury and His rebuke with flames of fire.
units.rightText: For, behold, Jehovah will come with fire, and his chariots shall be like the whirlwind; to render his anger with fierceness, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

units.leftText: For by fire and by His sword, the LORD will execute judgment on all flesh, and many will be slain by the LORD.
units.rightText: For by fire will Jehovah execute judgment, and by his sword, upon all flesh; and the slain of Jehovah shall be many.

units.leftText: “Those who consecrate and purify themselves to enter the groves — to follow one in the center of those who eat the flesh of swine and vermin and rats — will perish together,” declares the LORD.
units.rightText: They that sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go unto the gardens, behind one in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, they shall come to an end together, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “And I, knowing their deeds and thoughts, am coming to gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see My glory.
units.rightText: For I know their works and their thoughts: the time cometh, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and shall see my glory.
leftNotes: 66:18 Literally And I, their deeds and their thoughts, am coming

units.leftText: I will establish a sign among them, and I will send survivors from among them to the nations — to Tarshish, Put, and the archers of Lud; to Tubal, Javan, and the islands far away who have not heard of My fame or seen My glory.
units.rightText: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send such as escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the nations.
leftNotes: 66:19 Or coastlands

units.leftText: And they will bring all your brothers from all the nations as a gift to the LORD on horses and chariots and wagons, on mules and camels, to My holy mountain Jerusalem,” says the LORD, “just as the Israelites bring an offering in a clean vessel to the house of the LORD.”
units.rightText: And they shall bring all your brethren out of all the nations for an oblation unto Jehovah, upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon dromedaries, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith Jehovah, as the children of Israel bring their oblation in a clean vessel into the house of Jehovah.

units.leftText: “And I will select some of them as priests and Levites,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: And of them also will I take for priests and for Levites, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “For just as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, will endure before Me,” declares the LORD, “so your descendants and your name will endure.
units.rightText: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith Jehovah, so shall your seed and your name remain.
leftNotes: 66:22 LXX the new heaven and the new earth; see also Isaiah 65:17|ISA 65:17* and Revelation 21:1.

units.leftText: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come to worship before Me,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “As they go forth, they will see the corpses of the men who have rebelled against Me; for their worm will never die, their fire will never be quenched, and they will be a horror to all mankind.”
units.rightText: And they shall go forth, and look upon the dead bodies of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
leftNotes: 66:24 Cited in Mark 9:48|MRK 9:48*
